items.title: Every 3D artist should have an AI assistant, Maxon says as it launches new tools and agentic licences
items.excerpt: Maxon Plus brings AI 3D model generation into Cinema 4D and ZBrush, browser-based 3D review, and new 'agentic licences' for Cinema 4D and Autograph, with an off switch for artists who don't want generation.

items.title: Boris FX releases Silhouette 2027
items.excerpt: Silhouette 2027 adds ML nodes that bridge AI mattes and manual roto: Body ML generates editable roto shapes for body parts and tracks them, Roto ML fits shapes to AI mattes, plus a Video Inpaint ML node for object removal.

items.title: Higgsfield launches playable game ads built with AI
items.excerpt: Higgsfield's enterprise 'playable ads' workflow generates interactive ads from a described mechanic, genre and up to 100 uploaded sprites/textures/sounds; playable games can also be generated via Claude through Higgsfield MCP. (Off-list; overlap risk with games/marketing.)

items.title: Relight and Generative Restyle in Photoshop: hands-on
items.excerpt: Hands-on tests of Photoshop's new Relight (up to three movable AI lights) and Generative Restyle (shifts a scene's mood) on real photos. (Off-list.)

items.title: See what 6 builders are making with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.excerpt: Six creative-coding projects built with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, from rainy sci-fi skies and pixelated koi ponds to an interactive moth. (Gemini is saturated; low priority.)

history_match.title: Transform notes, research, and sources into interactive sites with Gemini Notebook

items.title: This AI can rebuild the Colosseum in 3D from a single photo
items.excerpt: 'Building Rome from a Single Image' (Applied Intuition + three US universities) turns one photo into an explorable 3D mesh scene, generating even structures hidden behind walls and trees. (Off-list; vr/world-model bucket had no fresh on-list item.)

history_match.title: Berrypicking still beats the single answer for search, even in the world of AI

items.title: Buro Happold and Motif bridge the BIM collaboration divide
items.excerpt: Buro Happold's open-source BHoM engineering framework is being integrated into Motif's BIM 2.0 platform so Motif's agents, which turn sketches and prompts into geometry, can call deterministic engineering methods for sizing and calcs. Early demo.

items.title: Octave advances AI workflows with engineering partners
items.excerpt: Octave CoLabs: MAIRE and Fluor are building agentic workflows on their own data to automate planning, P&ID compliance checks and 3D model design reviews. (Plant engineering; weak design hook.)

items.title: SK에코플랜트, 설계에도 AI 적용…도면 검토·장비 배치 업무 줄인다 (AXen)
items.excerpt: SK Ecoplant put its design-specialised AI platform AXen into operation: it proposes space/equipment layouts from accumulated design data, compares alternatives, detects clashes and suggests fixes, and searches codes and standards; designer-approved results feed back into the model. Part of a '1 person 1 agent' push. (Off-list Korean design-AX case.)

items.title: Pin agent spacing to the existing spacing scale — no magic margin or padding values
items.excerpt: Coding agents sprinkle one-off values like mt-[13px] into layouts; the fix is to hand them the design system's spacing scale and reject off-scale values. (Practitioner post, part of a series.)

items.title: Give the agent the existing icon component set, not a new icon pack or inline SVG dump
items.excerpt: Agents paste 40-line inline SVGs or add a second icon library; point them at the design system's existing Icon components first. (Same series as the spacing post.)

items.title: Prototypes have always been the most effective specification — especially with AI
items.excerpt: When an AI-built working version costs an afternoon, the prototype replaces the requirements doc as the spec; open questions answer themselves once the team can click the thing. (Essay; date from outlet RSS since article is Cloudflare-gated.)

items.title: Design for the Verify: 5 UX patterns for trustworthy AI
items.excerpt: LexisNexis's design team lays out five UX patterns that let users verify AI output in a professional legal-research product. (Off-list.)

items.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
items.excerpt: GPT-6.2 Sol becomes ChatGPT's default chat model worldwide; OpenAI says image understanding jumped from 47.4 to 71.7 percent in internal tests and difficult-instruction handling reached 78.1 percent.

items.title: Adobe doesn't want to force AI down your throat
items.excerpt: Adobe VP Deepa Subramaniam on how Adobe's AI tools have changed while its 'creative choice' pitch hasn't, and how it lets creatives opt in or out of generation. (Interview feature.)

items.title: Adobe and Microsoft bring AI editing and Express templates to Windows Photos
items.excerpt: Adobe AI editing and Adobe Express templates arrive inside Windows Photos, and Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects and Substance 3D Painter (beta) are optimised for Arm Windows PCs including the Surface Laptop Ultra. (Off-list; gadgets overlap risk.)
